rationale: The plan correctly identifies the 3' tag-seq property, refuses any TPM/FPKM or length offset, runs DESeq2 on raw counts with median-of-ratios inside the model, design ~ condition, BH at 0.05 and apeglm shrinkage, and flags low power at n=3. The low-count floor of 10 in 3 samples is the full-length default rather than the lower floor appropriate for a tag library, and the reference level is not explicitly set. QC lists library size and PCA/correlation but gives no concrete outlier policy or coloring. Enrichment was not asked and the reference omits it; the plan adds GSEA/ORA without an explicit ORA universe, collection version, or gene-set size window, and leaves the ranking metric ambiguous. The report omits package versions.
